name: zvid_image_calc_pow2_scratch_fields
description: zVid_Image::CalcPow2ScratchFields derives power-of-two shift, mask, fixed-point V mask, width-scale, and U-shift scratch fields from image dimensions.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage focuses on the scratch fields consumed by texture-directory loading.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x4902b0 validates the width and height right-shift loops, widthScale assignment, uShiftFrom20 calculation, uMask calculation, and fixed-point vMask calculation.
The native smoke verifies a 64x16 image and a small/negative-height edge case.
